backupChoiceTitle: What do you want to do?
backupAndroidStep1: Your videos are in {path}. Profiles are inside Profiles, movies inside Movies.
backupAndroidStep2: Open your phone's file manager (Files by Google, My Files, …) and go to Internal storage › DCIM › OneSecondDiary.
backupAndroidStep3: Select the whole folder and copy it to Google Drive, a computer or an SD card.
backupAndroidStep4: Tip: Google Photos can back this folder up by itself: in Google Photos › Backup › Back up device folders, turn on OneSecondDiary.
backupAndroidStep5: Do this again now and then; the app never uploads anything.
backupIosStep1: Your videos are in the Files app: On My iPhone › One Second Diary. Profiles are inside Profiles, movies inside Movies.
backupIosStep3: Touch and hold the One Second Diary folder › Copy, then paste it into iCloud Drive, or share it to a Mac with AirDrop.
backupIosStep4: Deleting the app deletes this folder. Back it up before you uninstall or change phones.
importAndroidStep1: Copy the OneSecondDiary folder (or just its videos) into {path} on this phone, keeping the Profiles folders as they were.
importStepDateNamed: A video from anywhere else can join the diary too: name it with its day, 2024-01-05.mp4 (or .mov), and put it in the same folder. A second video for that day is 2024-01-05-2.mp4.
importStepLook: Tap Look for new videos. The app also looks at every launch.
importStepProcessed: Videos that were not made by the app are marked Imported; the app offers to process them, so they get the date stamp and the profile's quality and movies stay fast.
importIosStep1: Tap Open in Files, then paste your backed-up OneSecondDiary folder (or its videos) into On My iPhone › One Second Diary, keeping the Profiles folders.
backupOpenInFilesFallback: Open the Files app, then On My iPhone › One Second Diary
backupOriginalsNote: OneSecondDiary Originals, next to it, holds original recordings. It may be left out of a backup.
processImportsKeepWhole: Keep the whole video (up to 60 s)
processImportsMoveRefused: Allow One Second Diary to move the original videos, or process them one by one
